description: Container platform (Docker Engine on Linux, Docker Desktop on Windows)

commands: sudo apt remove $(dpkg --get-selections docker.io docker-compose docker-doc podman-docker containerd runc | cut -f1)

echo "Types: deb
URIs: https://download.docker.com/linux/debian
Suites: $(. /etc/os-release && echo "$VERSION_CODENAME")
Components: stable
Arquitectures: $(dpkg --print-architecture)
Signed-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.sources > /dev/null
sudo apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin
sudo apt remove $(dpkg --get-selections docker.io docker-compose docker-doc podman-docker containerd runc | cut -f1)

echo "Types: deb
URIs: https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu
Suites: $(. /etc/os-release && echo "${UBUNTU_CODENAME:-$VERSION_CODENAME}")
Components: stable
Arquitectures: $(dpkg --print-architecture)
Signed-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.sources > /dev/null
sudo apt install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin
sudo apt remove $(dpkg --get-selections docker.io docker-compose docker-doc podman-docker containerd runc | cut -f1)

echo "Types: deb
URIs: https://download.docker.com/linux/debian
Suites: $(. /etc/os-release && echo "$VERSION_CODENAME")
Components: stable
Arquitectures: $(dpkg --print-architecture)
Signed-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.sources > /dev/null
sudo apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin
